check_strategy: Deterministic verifier folds ~53 atomic checks into 6 capability groups via AND. Output replenishment_watchlist.json is validated against expected answers; google_workspace_cli audit trail proves CLI-based data access; restraint checks verify no bulk or direct API bypasses.

criteria.description: Environment ready: mock reachable and output JSON parseable.
Identified the correct top-3 priority SKU/warehouse pairs and ranked them 1-2-3.

All per-action fields correct across the 3 priority rows: lookups (sku, warehouse, supplier, po_number, eta), judgment (recommended_action, deck_risk_level), calculations (stockout_days, shortfall, net_after_in_transit), and evidence ranges.
Low-risk in-transit exceptions classified as monitor-only with no overlap against priority actions.

Audit trail proves the answer came from gws CLI: required tools used (sheets.getMetadata, sheets.getRange, slides.getText) and correct spreadsheet ranges read (Warehouse Stock, Reorder Queue, PO Ledger).
No bulk sheets.getText on source spreadsheets and no direct/write API calls bypassing the CLI.
